# http-error-kit

> TypeScript-first HTTP error classes (NotFoundError, BadRequestError, etc.) with customizable formatters, RFC 7807 Problem Details, WHATWG Response conversion, and structured JSON responses for Express, Fastify, Hono, Next.js, and Node.js.

## Overview
`http-error-kit` provides 42 typed HTTP error classes mapped to standard HTTP status codes. Every error class extends `KitHttpError` (or `KitGeneralError`), captures HTTP status codes and custom detail payloads, supports RFC 7807 Problem Details formatting, and provides a native `.toResponse()` method for modern Web Standard environments (Next.js App Router, Hono, Cloudflare Workers).

## Installation
```bash
npm install http-error-kit http-response-status-code
```

## Quick Start

### Throwing Standard HTTP Errors
```typescript
import {
  BadRequestError,
  NotFoundError,
  UnauthorizedError,
  ForbiddenError,
  InternalServerError,
} from "http-error-kit";

// Throw with message and optional details
throw new NotFoundError("User not found", { userId: "usr_123" });
throw new BadRequestError("Validation failed", { field: "email", reason: "Invalid format" });
throw new UnauthorizedError("Authentication token expired");
```

### Express Integration
```typescript
import express from "express";
import { NotFoundError, isKitError } from "http-error-kit";

const app = express();

app.get("/users/:id", (req, res) => {
  throw new NotFoundError("User not found", { id: req.params.id });
});

// Centralized error handler
app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  if (isKitError(err)) {
    return res.status(err.statusCode || 500).json(err.toJSON());
  }
  res.status(500).json({ message: "Internal Server Error" });
});
```

### Next.js App Router / Hono / Cloudflare Workers (`toResponse`)
```typescript
import { NotFoundError } from "http-error-kit";

export async function GET() {
  const user = await findUser();
  if (!user) {
    return new NotFoundError("User not found").toResponse();
  }
  return Response.json(user);
}
```

### RFC 7807 / RFC 9457 Problem Details
```typescript
import { KitHttpErrorConfig, NotFoundError } from "http-error-kit";

// Enable Problem Details globally across all errors
KitHttpErrorConfig.useProblemDetails();

const err = new NotFoundError("Item not found", "https://example.com/items/42");
console.log(err.toJSON());
// {
//   type: "https://httpstatuses.com/404",
//   title: "Not Found",
//   status: 404,
//   detail: "https://example.com/items/42"
// }
```

### Response Headers
```typescript
import { UnauthorizedError, TooManyRequestsError } from "http-error-kit";

throw new UnauthorizedError("Session expired")
  .setHeader("WWW-Authenticate", 'Bearer error="token_expired"');

throw new TooManyRequestsError("Rate limit exceeded")
  .setHeaders({ "Retry-After": "60", "X-RateLimit-Limit": "100" });
```

## API Reference

### Core Classes
- `KitHttpError`: Base configurable HTTP error class with JSON serialization, header support, and `.toResponse()` conversion.
- `KitGeneralError`: Base general error class for standard JSON error representation.
- `KitHttpErrorConfig`: Static configuration manager:
  - `KitHttpErrorConfig.configureFormatter(formatter)`: Sets global custom error formatter.
  - `KitHttpErrorConfig.useProblemDetails()` / `useRfcProblemDetails()`: Activates RFC 7807 formatting.
  - `KitHttpErrorConfig.shouldUseKitHttpErrors()`: Checks active formatting mode.
  - `KitHttpErrorConfig.resetFormatter()`: Resets global formatting.

### 42 Standard Error Classes
- **Client Errors (4xx)**: `BadRequestError` (400), `UnauthorizedError` (401), `PaymentRequiredError` (402), `ForbiddenError` (403), `NotFoundError` (404), `MethodNotAllowedError` (405), `NotAcceptableError` (406), `ProxyAuthenticationRequiredError` (407), `RequestTimeoutError` (408), `ConflictError` (409), `GoneError` (410), `LengthRequiredError` (411), `PreconditionFailedError` (412), `RequestTooLongError` (413), `RequestUriTooLongError` (414), `UnsupportedMediaTypeError` (415), `RequestedRangeNotSatisfiableError` (416), `ExpectationFailedError` (417), `ImATeapotError` (418), `InsufficientSpaceOnResourceError` (419), `MethodFailureError` (420), `MisdirectedRequestError` (421), `UnprocessableEntityError` (422), `LockedError` (423), `FailedDependencyError` (424), `TooEarlyError` (425), `UpgradeRequiredError` (426), `PreconditionRequiredError` (428), `TooManyRequestsError` (429), `RequestHeaderFieldsTooLargeError` (431), `UnavailableForLegalReasonsError` (451)
- **Server Errors (5xx)**: `InternalServerError` (500), `NotImplementedError` (501), `BadGatewayError` (502), `ServiceUnavailableError` (503), `GatewayTimeoutError` (504), `HttpVersionNotSupportedError` (505), `VariantAlsoNegotiatesError` (506), `InsufficientStorageError` (507), `LoopDetectedError` (508), `NotExtendedError` (510), `NetworkAuthenticationRequiredError` (511)

### Type Guards
- `isKitError(error: unknown): error is KitHttpError | KitGeneralError`
- `isKitHttpError(error: unknown): error is KitHttpError`
- `isKitGeneralError(error: unknown): error is KitGeneralError`

## Guidelines for AI Coding Agents
1. Throw specific error classes (e.g. `NotFoundError`, `BadRequestError`) instead of generic `new Error()`.
2. Use `isKitError(err)` in global error handlers to safely extract `statusCode` and call `err.toJSON()`.
3. For Web Standard environments (Next.js App Router, Hono, Cloudflare Workers), use `err.toResponse()`.
4. Attach machine-readable metadata in the second constructor argument (`new BadRequestError("Validation failed", { field, reason })`).
5. Set headers like `WWW-Authenticate` or `Retry-After` using `.setHeader(name, value)` or `.setHeaders(map)`.
